gate: Raw life force, looking for somewhere to land. That is the heart of this code. A person carrying it feels an engine inside the body, a vitality that wants to move, do, push something real into the world. It is not power as dominance, and not power as volume. It is the simple fact of fuel being available, ready for whatever the body has actually agreed to. The misread is to call this code strong, or willful, or in charge. It is none of those by default. The strength only arrives when the action has a true yes underneath it, the kind that comes up from the gut before the mind has weighed in. Without that yes, the same energy turns into busyness and burns out fast. Used in alignment, the fuel is almost endless. Used to chase what was never really wanted, it grinds the body down and leaves the person feeling powerless inside their own force.
centre_field: This fuel is wired straight into the deepest motor of the body, the part of you that runs work, sex, vitality, and the quiet yes or no your gut already knows before the mind catches up. That placement is the whole teaching. Power, here, is not a personality trait. It is bound to the engine of the body itself, which means it only runs clean when the engine has been asked something and the engine has answered. This motor responds. It does not start from a thought in the head. So the force carried here has a condition built into it. It waits for something real to push against, something the body has already said yes to. When that condition gets honored, the energy is sustainable and almost bottomless. When the head overrides the gut and tells the body what to do anyway, the motor still runs, but it runs hot and empties fast.
channel: Most codes pair with a single partner to come alive. This one reaches for three at once, an unusually woven situation that sits deep inside a person's core wiring. The fuel here connects out to the part of you that holds who you are and how you behave, to the part that speaks and shows up in the present moment, and to the part that knows by instinct what is safe and true in any given second. Joined to the first, the power becomes the engine of authentic action, the body doing what is actually yours to do. Joined to the second, it becomes presence with weight behind it, voice and charisma that carry. Joined to the third, it becomes immediate instinct, the body knowing and moving in the same breath. On its own, the fuel has no aim. Reaching into all three partners at once, it sits inside a person whose force has many true directions to flow.
